@graph.category: Custom short-sleeve BJJ and MMA rash guard
@graph.color: Urban black / charcoal / slate grey / white

mainEntity.name: Can the camouflage and industrial-style graphics be customized?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Provide authorized artwork, color references, logo placements and label requirements. Approve the camouflage scale, sleeve layout and chest graphics on an artwork proof and physical sample.

mainEntity.name: What are the fabric composition and GSM?

acceptedAnswer.text: Final fiber composition, GSM, stretch and recovery are confirmed for the selected fabric. The supplied brief includes example values rather than a confirmed production specification.

mainEntity.name: Does the tactical design indicate military or protective certification?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Tactical and Spec-Ops describe the visual theme. This training garment is not presented as protective equipment or as military-certified apparel. Abrasion, moisture-management and durability requirements need agreed tests.

This product reference covers the short-sleeve rash guard. Matching shorts shown in styling photographs are a separate garment and require their own construction, sizing, quotation and sample approval.

mainEntity.name: Can it be used for No-Gi BJJ competitions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Confirm the organizer’s current color, coverage, branding and garment rules before specifying a competition version. This reference does not establish event approval.

mainEntity.name: How do I request MOQ, pricing and a sample?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send quantity by size, target market, delivery destination, artwork status and required date through the project builder. Confirm MOQ, sample costs, fabric, branding, lead time and packaging against the project brief.
